prompt: The vendor.vehicle_logger service on our Android Automotive build keeps exiting right after boot and init restarts it over and over. dmesg.txt and logcat.txt are from the device; both are full of SELinux denials, most of them harmless. Find the denial that actually stops vehicle_logger from running and tell me its scontext, tcontext, tclass and permission in one line. Then add the minimal allow rule that fixes it to sepolicy/vendor/vehicle_logger.te. Do not touch other files.
reference_answer: The enforced denial (permissive=0) is scontext=u:r:vendor_vehicle_logger:s0 tcontext=u:r:vendor_vehicle_bus:s0 tclass=unix_stream_socket { connectto }; I added allow vendor_vehicle_logger vendor_vehicle_bus:unix_stream_socket connectto; to sepolicy/vendor/vehicle_logger.te.
